reviewer: Official site and native JSON-LD evidence review (Claude, LOT 4 resume)

evidence.statement: hub-urbn.icims.com is the group career portal of URBN (Urban Outfitters, Inc.): the official site urbn.com links it as its careers destination, and it federates the tenant hosts of the group (stores, home office, supply chain, Menus & Venues, NA and EU). Each native posting page carries a schema.org JobPosting whose hiringOrganization names the employing brand with its own official site in sameAs (Anthropologie, Urban Outfitters, Free People, Terrain, Nuuly, Menus and Venues) or URBN itself. URBN cannot own every posting of this shared portal: postings naming a brand with its own official site are credited to that brand; postings naming URBN, a label without an official site (Reclectic) or carrying no JobPosting stay with URBN.

The official URBN page "Our Brands" presents Anthropologie, Urban Outfitters, Free People, FP Movement, Nuuly, Terrain and Menus & Venues as the group's brands; FP Movement is presented within Free People, and the posting pages point Anthro Weddings and Maeve to anthropologie.com.
